notes: Results site: search result titled 'Harris Votes - Election Results Archive' at harrisvotes.com/ElectionResults, plus 'Archives' at harrisvotes.com/Election-Results/Archives. Report files are PDFs on the county domain (appfiles.harrisvotes.com/harrisvotes/prd/Data/1124/cumulative.pdf for Nov 5 2024, Data/0326/rep-cumulative.pdf for Mar 3 2026 primary, Data/0525/cumulative.pdf for May 2025) and canvass reports on files.harrisvotes.com, so platform recorded as county_pdfs from URL pattern only; the live election-night page may be a homegrown HTML view that I could not inspect. Phone and email: the search tool summary listed 713-755-6965 and an obfuscated email for the Harris County Clerk elections office, attributed loosely to a harrisvotes.com/Contact-Us result, but the number did not appear in any result title, URL, or attributable quoted text, so it is a lead only and left empty; the email was rendered as '[email protected]' (obfuscated). Fetch module attempts to harrisvotes.com/Contact-Us and harrisvotes.com/Election-Results failed (robots_disallowed_or_unreachable). Wayback probe for appfiles.harrisvotes.com/harrisvotes/prd/Data/ failed for all three windows (robots_disallowed_or_unreachable). WebFetch attempts to fox26houston.com, votebeat.org and ballotpedia.org were all EGRESS_BLOCKED. No source found that states when precinct-level results appeared on election night for Nov 5 2024, Mar 3 2026, or May 26 2026. A search summary mentioned '240 out of 275 voting precinct reporting as of the morning of March 4' (communityimpact.com, lead only), which is a reporting-progress count, not evidence of precinct-level result posting. No 2025 or 2026 stated change to precinct-level reporting found. Usage notice: no source showed results-site notice text verbatim, so left empty.
tag_rationale: No citable source states when precinct-level results were posted on election night in Harris County; the existence of cumulative and canvass PDFs does not establish election-night timing.
